release_notes:
## [2.10.0](https://github.com/ginDoki19/GinArena-patch/compare/v2.9.1...v2.10.0) (2026-11-08)

## 🎉 GinArena Patch v2.10.0

This update adds experimental support for Daylio and improves Android TV remote controls across several streaming apps.

### ✨ New: Daylio support

- Added an **Enable premium (experimental)** patch for **Daylio 1.71.1** (build 289).
- The patch enables premium status locally. Features that depend on a Daylio account may not work.
- This patch is **off by default**. Enable it manually when patching if you want to try it.

### 📺 Better Android TV playback controls

- **CRICFy TV 7.4 and Playfy TV 1.7:** Playback controls now prefer the seekbar, making it easier to rewind or fast-forward with a remote.
- **CricZ TV 7.3, PlayZ TV 2.3.1, CrexiFy TV 4.5, and SK Tech TV 2.7:** Improved remote focus and opening playback controls with the OK button.
- These improvements apply to the embedded and fullscreen players. The **Improve Android TV playback controls** patch is enabled by default.

> Some live streams do not support rewinding or fast-forwarding, even when the seekbar is accessible.

### 📦 How to update

Refresh the GinArena patch source in Morphe Manager, then patch a **fresh stock app** with the new patches. To update an existing patched installation, use the same Morphe signing key. If Android reports a signature conflict, back up your data before considering an uninstall.

**Full changes:** [v2.9.1 → v2.10.0](https://github.com/ginDoki19/GinArena-patch/compare/v2.9.1...v2.10.0)
